title: New Customer's representative field looks as designed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide with the zoom at 100%, and the design pictures "customer-16-n2-new.png" (board 2.16), "customer-17-n2-new-menu.png" (board 2.17) and "customer-18-n2-new-ps.png" (board 2.18) attached to this case are open beside it at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and dates in the pictures are sample data.
  • Three active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A}, {Sales-rep-B} and {Sales-rep-C}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able, {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able and {Sales-rep-C} is ZZAUTOTEST Cara Able.
  • Starting screen: the Customers page is open in that browser window.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open New Customer and compare with the picture of board 2.16.
  2. Type a customer name, click the + and compare with the picture of board 2.17.
  3. Add "Sales Representative - Part Sales", pick {Sales-rep-C} in it and compare with the picture of board 2.18.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the same optional "Sales Representative" field and + as Edit Customer, in the same spot.
  • Step 2: the same two options as Edit Customer.
  • Step 3: "Sales Representative" and "Sales Representative - Part Sales" {Sales-rep-C} with its remove x, as in the picture.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 19 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives)

  • S4-R1: “The Edit Customer window and the New Customer window both show a Sales Representative field, in the place Edit Customer shows it today, with the outlined box every other field in the window has.”
  • S4-R6: “Its menu lists, in this order, each field not yet added: "Sales Representative - Service Parts" and "Sales Representative - Part Sales". When both are added the + is not shown.”
  • S4-R8: “Adding Part Sales shows "Sales Representative - Part Sales" last. It starts with the person new part sales get at that moment (S4-R26), or "Unassigned".”
  • S4-R10: “Service Parts and Part Sales each have the remove x of S2-R8 to their right, with the tooltip "Remove Sales Representative - Service Parts" or "Remove Sales Representative - Part Sales". The first field has the + instead, while there is something left to add, and otherwise no button.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), export read 19 Oct 2026, boards 2.16 New Customer: the same field; 2.17 New Customer: the + menu; 2.18 New Customer with a Part Sales rep (the attached pictures are these boards).

Design pictures attached to this case: customer-16-n2-new.png, customer-17-n2-new-menu.png, customer-18-n2-new-ps.png.

  • Design — board 2.16 title: “2.16 New Customer: the same field”
  • Design — board 2.16 note: “Decision 34: New Customer gets the same optional Sales Representative field and +, in the same spot as on Edit Customer.”
  • Design — board 2.17 title: “2.17 New Customer: the + menu”
  • Design — board 2.17 note: “The same two options as Edit Customer. (A name is typed so the window shows no required-field message.)”
  • Design — board 2.18 title: “2.18 New Customer with a Part Sales rep”
  • Design — board 2.18 note: “Part Sales added on its own: "Sales Representative" and "Sales Representative - Part Sales", with its remove x. Same rows and rules as Edit Customer.”
